ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High dominance of low-intensity pixels. Approximately 90-95% dark/black pixel coverage versus 5-10% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark field across both lobes. Dense, high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the distal tips. Sparse white circular points and fine linear markings distributed across the medial and lateral surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 45-50 degrees relative to the vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, sharp serrations. Visible peaks and valleys ranging from approximately 5 to 20 pixels in depth relative to the edge mean.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex curve fitted to the outer boundaries, sweeping from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Scattered individual white circular scars present on the lower margins and central lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (scratches/rake marks). Multiple diagonal marks visible on the right lobe; finer horizontal and vertical lines visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the lateral tips. Numerous circular white 'halo' scars across the dark ventral surface indicative of detached sessile organisms.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, high-contrast white circular ring mark located in the lower-medial section of the left lobe.
